## What's the improvement

A clear and concise description of the improvement.

## Where

- File: `path/to/file.md` (or `path/to/file.tsx` for in-code comments)
- Section: the heading or section
- Line (if known): the line number

## Why

Why is this improvement valuable? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed wording

If you have proposed wording for the change, include it here.

## Is this a Maintainer-only change?

The admin repo requires Maintainer approval for all merged PRs, including docs. Tick whichever applies:

- [ ] This is a typo, broken link, or small factual correction — still needs Maintainer approval to merge, but trivial to review
- [ ] This is a substantive docs change (new section, rewritten guidance, governance clarification)
- [ ] This affects what admin behaviour is or isn't acceptable — needs Maintainer discussion before merge

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant.
